scientific_question: Among fully species-disjoint Lepidoptera, does overlap in native larval host-resource geography predict congruent post-IBD spatial genetic structure beyond insect sampling geometry and simple resource breadth?

empirical_response.marker: frozen COI-family aligned FASTA selected before identity opening
empirical_response.edge_genetic_distance: uncorrected p-distance, arithmetic mean across all canonical A/C/G/T cross-locality sequence pairs meeting the frozen comparable-column threshold
empirical_response.ibd_adjustment: endpoint-disjoint cross-fit rank-IBD residualization on each species frozen graph
empirical_response.edge_response: rank01 of the endpoint-disjoint cross-fit IBD residual; identical response definition for source and target species

host_resource_estimand.pair_alignment: exact response-blind survivor-design target/source edge alignment inherited from v0.2 qualification
host_resource_estimand.pair_transfer_congruence: Pearson correlation between aligned source and target post-IBD edge-response values
host_resource_estimand.raw_predictor: Jaccard similarity of native, extant, non-doubtful WCVP-v13 WGSRPD3 larval host-resource footprint sets
host_resource_estimand.per_target_statistic: Pearson correlation across supported source species between residualized host-resource Jaccard and pairwise transfer congruence
host_resource_estimand.panel_statistic: arithmetic mean over finite supported evaluation-target correlations
host_resource_estimand.inference: worst-case one-sided upper-tail Monte Carlo envelope across independent v0.2 private, geometry-confounded and host-breadth-confounded nuisance reference distributions

reference_distributions.calibration: maximum of +1 corrected one-sided upper-tail Monte Carlo p-values

one_shot_decision.positive: panel statistic > 0 and worst-case envelope p <= 0.05
one_shot_decision.interpretation_positive: Within the exact frozen host-resource survivor domain, Lepidoptera sharing more native larval host-resource geography show greater congruence in post-IBD mitochondrial spatial differentiation beyond sampling geometry and simple resource breadth.
one_shot_decision.interpretation_negative: The frozen study does not detect a positive host-resource-geography gradient within the tested survivor domain; this does not establish that host-resource geography has zero effect.

integrity_requirements: Exact source archive SHA-256 must match before nucleotide identity is decoded.
Reconstruct all 431 frozen survivor source panels from headers and occurrence coordinates and require exact geometry equality with the v0.2 survivor design.
Recompute canonical-valid masks and require every survivor frozen edge to remain admissible before identity opening.
Use only the exact frozen v0.2 nuisance reference distributions; no null reselection after the empirical statistic is seen.
Run the empirical statistic exactly once; no predictor, host taxonomy, WCVP footprint, geometry covariate, alignment, response, split, threshold or nuisance-family change after opening.
